thesis: Maintained H1 profit and cash generation support resilience, but network funding and payout coverage remain unquantified. Neither establishes a clear return advantage.
strongest_counterexample: Service revenue is growing, efficiencies are progressing and cash flow exceeds snapshot profit.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters with FCF below cash dividends.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of positive operating-profit growth with FCF above cash dividends.
evidence_gaps: Current network capex, financing obligations and distribution coverage.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: Stable H1 profit and positive cash generation support recurring-service resilience
Maintained H1 profit and cash generation support a resilient telecom business
